source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag CCU Top-Load Dryer Service Data Sheet
source.extractedTextFile: backend/docs/manuals/WPL Top load Dryer Service Manual-extracted.txt

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Service Diagnostics entered. Use Diagnostics Home or Component Activation as needed, then continue below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After diagnostic entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: Automatic cycle + dryness menu
steps.body: Select automatic cycle. Hold Dryness Level ~3 sec for Customer-Focused Dryness screen.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Select automatic cycle. Hold Dryness Level ~3 sec for Customer-Focused Dryness screen.

steps.title: Select dryness offset
steps.body: Choose Factory Preset, 15% More, 30% More, 15% Less, or 30% Less. Stored in CCU EEPROM.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Choose Factory Preset, 15% More, 30% More, 15% Less, or 30% Less. Stored in CCU EEPROM.
